# 74153 - Dual 4-line-to-1-line data selector/multiplexer

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74153.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74153.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 29 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74153 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74153.png) | ![74153 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74153.png) | ![74153 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74153.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 14 | A | input |  |  | select, common to both sections, least significant |
| 2 | B | input |  |  | select, common to both sections |
| 1 | 1G | enable | low |  | controls pins 7; when not enabled: low |
| 6 | 1C0 | input |  |  |  |
| 5 | 1C1 | input |  |  |  |
| 4 | 1C2 | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | 1C3 | input |  |  |  |
| 7 | 1Y | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 15 | 2G | enable | low |  | controls pins 9; when not enabled: low |
| 10 | 2C0 | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | 2C1 | input |  |  |  |
| 12 | 2C2 | input |  |  |  |
| 13 | 2C3 | input |  |  |  |
| 9 | 2Y | output |  | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | 1Y = 1G' AND ((B'A' AND 1C0) OR (B'A AND 1C1) OR (BA' AND 1C2) OR (BA AND 1C3)) | When 1G is low, 1Y follows the 1C input picked by B,A; when 1G is high, 1Y is low. |
| 9 | 2Y = 2G' AND ((B'A' AND 2C0) OR (B'A AND 2C1) OR (BA' AND 2C2) OR (BA AND 2C3)) | When 2G is low, 2Y follows the 2C input picked by B,A; when 2G is high, 2Y is low. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 30 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Data | Y | PLH | 12 | 18 |
| Data | Y | PHL | 15 | 23 |
| Select | Y | PLH | 22 | 34 |
| Select | Y | PHL | 22 | 34 |
| Strobe | Y | PLH | 19 | 30 |
| Strobe | Y | PHL | 15 | 23 |
